description: This file defines a SplashScreen activity for an Android weather app. It displays a splash screen for 4 seconds, then launches the HomeActivity.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a splash screen for 4 seconds before navigating to the HomeActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the binding layout, removes the status bar, and starts the splash timer.

methods.name: splashScreen
methods.description: Sets a delay of 4 seconds, after which it navigates to HomeActivity and finishes the current activity.
